segments.name: Weave platform
segments.description: Provides communications and payments services to small and medium-sized healthcare practices through a single SaaS software platform.
segments.evidence: The Company has one reportable segment: Weave platform.

revenueModel.text: Healthcare practices pay subscription fees for access to the software platform and phone service, plus payment processing services.
revenueModel.evidence: Subscriptions revenue (software and phone service) is generated from fees that provide customers access to one or more of the Company's software applications and related services.
